ana: incoming from support  customers hitting 404s on pricing quota anchors and the metering header examples still show Authorization: Bearer. can someone pick this up?
mike: send the broken path?
ana: /pricing#quota-tiers 404, and /docs/metering/headers.md shows old header + legacy method names in snippets.
peter: sounds like panel/anchor rename. i suggest adding redirects for old anchors and updating examples to x-api-key + client.generate(...) in both py/ts.
zoe: i'll take the snippets and migration blurb. will add tiny worked example for burst credits (one-liner formula + numeric example) and a short python helper.
mike: +1 for redirects.yml entry. also add a small unit test to assert redirects exist (run locally first).
nana: enterprise customers still on docs-1.2, please backport after main merge.
docs-bot: PR #4899 opened by zoe  "docs: pricing anchors redirect + metering header snippets". reviewers: @mike, @peter. CI: queued.
zoe: draft py snippet: ```python
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
resp = c.generate(model='rwd/light-2', input='hi', headers={'x-api-key': os.environ['RW_KEY']})
print(resp.output)
```
zoe: draft ts snippet: ```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd/light-2', input: 'hi' }, { headers: { 'x-api-key': process.env.RW_KEY } })
console.log(resp.output)
```
mike: tiny nit: don't show raw key in logs, use env var only in examples.
zoe: noted. checklist in PR desc: 1) redirects.yml entry, 2) update pricing anchors, 3) update metering snippets + migration note, 4) add burst credits worked example, 5) backport to 1.2.
peter: i'll review after CI. thanks.
nana: thanks all, ping when staging preview is up. :thumbsup:
